package.name: asio_vendor
package.description: Installs the standalone Asio C++ networking headers (version 1.30.2), patched for VxWorks, so Fast-DDS can consume them. Fast-DDS requires Asio >= 1.13.0; 1.30.2 satisfies that and matches Ubuntu 26.04 (resolute) libasio-dev. Header-only: the vendor stages the patched include/ tree into the shared install prefix. VxWorks patches: unistd platform flag, socketpair unsupported, sys/poll include, and the IP_MULTICAST_LOOP 1-byte optlen workaround (ported from the Wind River Boost.Asio VxWorks patch).
